description: Calibration fixture for measuring resolver hit rate + precision. Per the plan's §Calibration section: estimates in SKILL.md should be replaced with measured numbers once a labeled set of real targets is built.
notes_for_user: Ground-truth emails are intentionally null in the committed fixture (this repo is public — don't commit other people's addresses). Add your own targets and their known emails in `tests/fixtures/calibration_targets.local.json` (gitignored). The measurement harness merges the public fixture with the local overrides.
